Each entry is followed by tiny wrappers (`e52de004 push {lr}`, `e3a05004/#8/#0xc/#0x10/#0x14 mov r5,<block offset>`, `e3a06010/#8/#4/#2 mov r6,<block size>`, `bl <entry>`, `bl 0x001352a0`, `e49df004 pop {pc}`), which is the per-block call site and proves this is a block prediction kernel feeding Video_DecodeSubblockMask.
